en.name: Nutrition supplement drinks, canned
en.summary: An unopened can of nutrition supplement drink keeps 2–5 years from purchase in a cool, dark cupboard, and 2 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below once opened. The can is a near-perfect oxygen barrier, which is what makes the unopened figure so long.
en.pantry: 2–5 years from purchase, unopened, in a cool, dark, dry cupboard, and go by the printed date on the can. The contents are sterilised at high temperature and sealed into metal, so there is nothing alive inside and no oxygen getting in; what eventually limits the can is slow degradation of the vitamins and the fat, which heat accelerates. Keep cases away from the boiler and off a sunny shelf, and never use a can that is swollen, rusted through at a seam or leaking.
en.fridge: 2 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below once opened. The moment the can is open this is essentially milk — neutral, rich in protein and sugar, with no acidity to hold anything back — so cap it or decant it, refrigerate it immediately and finish it within two days. Pour into a glass rather than drinking from the can if you are keeping the rest. These drinks are often given to the elderly, the ill and the tube-fed, and that is exactly why the two-day limit is worth respecting.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for canned nutrition drinks, and freezing is a poor idea regardless. They are emulsions of protein, fat and sugar, and freezing breaks the emulsion: what thaws is grainy and separated, which matters both for palatability and for anyone using it through a tube. Buy the can size that matches a sitting instead.
en.thawing: Not recommended. If a can has frozen accidentally, thaw it in the fridge and expect the texture to have separated; shaking helps but does not fully restore it.
spoilage: A swollen or bulging can — do not open it and do not taste it.
Rust along a seam, a dent on the seam itself, or any sign of leakage.
A sour, cheesy or fermented smell on opening.
Curdling, lumps or a separated layer that will not shake back in.
tips: Buy the can size that matches one sitting; an opened can is a two-day item.
Decant leftovers into a capped glass rather than storing them in the open can.
Rotate stock so the oldest cases are used first.
For someone vulnerable, note the time the can was opened, not just the date.

faq.q: How long do canned nutrition drinks keep?
faq.a: 2–5 years from purchase unopened in a cool, dark cupboard, and 2 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below once opened.

faq.q: Does an opened can need refrigerating?
faq.a: Yes, immediately. Once opened it behaves like milk, and it should be finished within two days.

faq.q: Can you freeze a nutrition supplement drink?
faq.a: No freezer timeline is published, and freezing breaks the emulsion, leaving it grainy and separated. It is not worth doing.

zh.name: 罐裝營養補充飲品
zh.summary: 未開封的罐裝營養補充飲品，自購買日起放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃可放 2～5 年；開封後放 4 °C 以下冷藏 2 天。鐵罐幾乎是完美的阻氧屏障，未開封的數字之所以這麼長，靠的就是它。
zh.pantry: 未開封，放陰涼、避光、乾燥的櫥櫃，自購買日起 2～5 年，並以罐上印的日期為準。內容物經過高溫滅菌並封進金屬罐，裡面沒有活著的東西，氧氣也進不去；最後限制它的是維生素與油脂緩慢降解，而高溫會加速這件事。整箱請遠離熱水器、也別放在有陽光的層架上；罐身鼓脹、接縫生鏽穿孔或滲漏的，絕對不要使用。
zh.fridge: 開封後放 4 °C 以下冷藏 2 天。罐子一開，它基本上就是牛奶——中性、富含蛋白質與糖，又沒有酸度可以擋住什麼——所以請蓋好或倒出來，立刻冷藏，並在兩天內喝完。要留下一些的話，請倒進杯子喝，不要對著罐口喝。這類飲品常常是給長者、病人與管灌者的，而這正是那個兩天上限值得認真對待的理由。
zh.freezer: 罐裝營養補充飲品沒有公布的冷凍期限，而且不管怎麼說，冷凍都不是好主意。它是蛋白質、油脂與糖的乳化液，冷凍會破壞乳化：解凍後粗糙分離，不只難喝，對使用管灌的人來說更是實際問題。請改成買一次喝得完的罐型。
zh.thawing: 不建議。若不小心凍到，請放冷藏解凍，並預期質地已經分離；搖勻會好一些，但回不到原樣。
spoilage: 罐身鼓脹或膨起——不要開，也不要嚐。
接縫生鏽、接縫處被撞凹，或任何滲漏跡象。
打開時有酸味、起司味或發酵味。
結絮、出現顆粒，或分層後搖不回來。
tips: 買一次喝得完的罐型；開過的罐子就是兩天的東西。
喝剩的倒進有蓋的杯子，不要就放在開口的罐子裡。
先進先出，最舊的那箱先用。
給體弱者飲用時，請記下「開罐時間」，不要只記日期。

faq.q: 罐裝營養補充飲品可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開封放陰涼避光的櫥櫃，自購買日起 2～5 年；開封後 4 °C 以下冷藏 2 天。

faq.q: 開過的罐子需要冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 需要，而且要立刻。開封後它的行為就像牛奶，並且應在兩天內喝完。

faq.q: 營養補充飲品可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 沒有公布的冷凍期限，而且冷凍會破壞乳化，解凍後粗糙分離，不值得這麼做。
